children.game_version: Roleplay winter sweeper clearing the snow while marching in pairs.

seniors.seated_version: Perform arm patterns and upper body set steps while seated in facing rows.
seniors.standing_version: Gentle marching in place or light longways steps with lowered impact.

learning_units.description: Basic heavy step march in longways formation

social_formats.description: Longways set formed of facing lines

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Natural down swings or holding set positions, free of handkerchiefs
movement_profile.footwork: Heavy stepping rather than light leaps
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Longways sets moving along street paths or open outdoor spaces
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Stiff, functional torso movement suited to winter outdoor performance
movement_profile.posture: Upright yet grounded with a heavy, unrefined weight

signature_moves.description: Broom bearer clearing space ahead of the set
signature_moves.name: Sweeper march

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid delicate Cotswold-style handkerchief flicks, ankle bells, or light high hops

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Straight marching or social dance pulse
music_profile.sound_description: A rhythmic, rustic winter sound driven by accordion, concertina, or fiddle playing popular tunes, sometimes supported by basic percussion.

basic_steps: Heavy forward stepping in longways set formation

teaching.level_notes: Beginners focus on grounded, heavy stepping and simple social set patterns.
